reviews.reading_evidence: Full reading of all twelve lines of 557 source and both targets: proud brewing storm, hazy eyes, deafening trumpet as weapon, frail bodies wearing resilient faith, pelting rain silencing uproar and howls seized rather than escaping. The original shift from plural howls to singular it was inspected.
reviews.reason: Hazy describes obscured vision rather than grey eye colour. Equipping itself with the trumpet better carries armed than merely decorating itself.
open_questions: Final English it after plural howls is ambiguous; current targets attach seizure to the howls without identifying another being. Keep this source-agreement question open.
reviews.tradeoff: Preserve original images, repetition, line/stanza boundaries and credits.
